title: Choosing a Tailwind CSS Development Setup knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which principle is most useful when applying Choosing a Tailwind CSS Development Setup?
options: It removes the need to understand HTML semantics, the CSS cascade or browser behavior.
It makes every interface responsive and accessible without testing.
It runs all utility classes as JavaScript in the browser.
the installed package and build-tool integration must match the documented workflow
questions.answer_key: the installed package and build-tool integration must match the documented workflow
questions.explanation: Choosing a Tailwind CSS Development Setup is best understood through the syllabus topics: Standalone HTML projects, Vite-based projects, PostCSS-based setups. Choose the technique deliberately and verify the result.

questions.prompt: Which workflow is strongest when working with choosing a tailwind css development setup?
options: Assume that starting a development server proves every page and state works.
Skip narrow-screen testing because utility-first CSS is automatically responsive.
follow the official install guide for the current toolchain and verify that the stylesheet is imported
Add classes until a screenshot looks acceptable without inspecting generated CSS.
questions.answer_key: follow the official install guide for the current toolchain and verify that the stylesheet is imported
questions.explanation: A reliable workflow checks generated CSS and the actual interface. Related topics include: Standalone HTML projects, Vite-based projects, PostCSS-based setups, Framework-specific installations.

questions.prompt: Which common mistake should you avoid when applying choosing a tailwind css development setup?
options: Check keyboard states where controls are involved.
mixing incompatible v3 and v4 setup instructions can prevent styles from compiling
Document intended behavior and test representative content.
Use the official documentation for version-specific behavior.
questions.answer_key: mixing incompatible v3 and v4 setup instructions can prevent styles from compiling
questions.explanation: Good styling work is verified, version-aware and tested with realistic content and input methods.
